title: Senior Design & AI Engineer
role_line: Senior Design & AI Engineer · AI platform, agents & governance

experience.title: Senior Design & AI Engineer
experience.summary: Building the company AI platform, largely as its sole engineer: the gateway, retrieval, agents, evaluation and governance that let the engineering organisation use AI safely.

points.text: Wrote the security case that got Claude approved company-wide, then led the Claude Code rollout across engineering (about 100 engineers) to daily use on every shared engineering host, under a policy set by IT that users cannot override, with credentials protected and activity logged per user.

Moved company RAG from a self-built platform (LangGraph, Temporal, Weaviate, vLLM) to AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases, now used by about 100 engineers through Open WebUI: one company-wide base, plus a base per customer project visible only to that team via IAM Identity Center and Entra ID.

Made retrieval quality measurable (Recall@k, MRR, nDCG, faithfulness, LLM-as-judge), which overturned assumptions: replaced a reranker that was cutting nDCG by 39% with a generation model, caught 18% of the corpus silently converted to empty text, and lifted a failing sanity set from 1/10 to 8/10.

Designing and building an agentic project-delivery platform to keep complex engineering projects on time and observable. Each project is a graph of owned tasks with typed inputs and outputs, so work hands over cleanly between domains and every result traces back to the customer requirement.

Designed the company AI platform's foundations around LiteLLM as a single gateway, so any team reaches any model, on Bedrock or self-hosted, through one API. Temporal workflows to orchestrate AI calls; PostgreSQL, Weaviate, Neo4j and MinIO for storage.
Built compute and licence analytics over a 3.3M-job Slurm archive and 1,300+ FlexLM features; management uses it to forecast licence use per project and cut memory waste.
